title: Structural, magnetic, and magnetocaloric properties of the multiferroic host double perovskite compound Pr                     <sub>2</sub>                     FeCrO                     <sub>6</sub>
abstract: Three different magnetic phase alterations,                     viz.                     canted antiferromagnetism, spin-reorientation, and C-type antiferromagnetism, and the magnetocaloric properties of the disordered Pr                     2                     FeCrO                     6                     double perovskite have been reported in this article.
